title: Student Identity Disclosure
description: Student (EE1) is exposed to the Grades Portal Web App (P1) during the login and submission process. The student's identity is transmitted to the external process, which may log or store this information, creating a privacy risk.
assumptions: The student's identity is not encrypted or anonymized before transmission.

title: Data Processing of Student Information
description: The Grades Portal Web App (P1) processes student data (student id, course, submission timestamp) and may store or log this information, creating a privacy risk.
assumptions: The portal does not use encryption or anonymization for the stored data.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The data flow transmits student identifiers (student id, course, file reference) from the Portal Web App (P1) to the Assignment & Grading Service (P2). This constitutes an Identifying threat (I) as the data contains unique references to the identity of the data subject.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The data flow transmits student identifiers (student id, course, file reference) from the Assignment & Grading Service (P2) back to the Portal Web App (P1). This constitutes an Identifying threat (I) as the data contains unique references to the identity of the data subject.

title: Assignment File Disclosure
description: The assignment file containing student personal data (student id, course, submission time) is transferred from the Assignment & Grading Service (Process P2) to the Assignment Store (DataStore DS1). This constitutes a Data Disclosure (D) threat as it represents the transfer of personal data across a boundary to a data store.

title: Assignment File Storage
description: The Assignment Store (DataStore DS1) receives the assignment file and stores it. This is a Data Disclosure (D) threat as the data is transferred from the process to the data store, which is a boundary crossing.

title: Teacher's Data Access
description: Teacher (EE3) requests and processes the queue of submissions to review for their courses, which may contain personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data.
assumptions: The teacher has access to the queue of submissions and the system processes this data.

title: System Data Processing
description: The Grades Portal Web App (P1) processes the queue of submissions, which may contain personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data.
assumptions: The system processes the queue of submissions.

title: Data Leakage
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) may inadvertently expose student names, work content, and submission times to the external Teacher entity (EE3) without proper access controls or encryption.
assumptions: The portal is accessible to the teacher, and the teacher has the necessary permissions to view this data.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the teacher has explicit permission to view this specific data set. Assuming access is granted for the purpose of this analysis.

title: Data Leakage
description: External Entity EE3 (Teacher) may access or share student names, work content, and submission times with unauthorized parties or entities outside the system.
assumptions: The teacher has access to the portal and may share this information with others.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the teacher is aware of the data sensitivity or if they are sharing it with others.

title: Teacher records grade
description: Teacher (EE3) directly inputs a student's grade and feedback text into the system. This action exposes sensitive personal data (student ID, feedback content) to the system without any prior validation or filtering, creating a direct privacy risk.
assumptions: The teacher has access to the student's personal information.

title: Teacher records feedback
description: Teacher (EE3) directly inputs a student's feedback text into the system. This action exposes sensitive personal data (student ID, feedback content) to the system without any prior validation or filtering, creating a direct privacy risk.
assumptions: The teacher has access to the student's personal information.

title: Process receives grade
description: Process (P1) directly receives a student's grade and feedback text. This action exposes sensitive personal data (student ID, feedback content) to the system without any prior validation or filtering, creating a direct privacy risk.
assumptions: The process has access to the student's personal information.

title: Process receives feedback
description: Process (P1) directly receives a student's feedback text. This action exposes sensitive personal data (student ID, feedback content) to the system without any prior validation or filtering, creating a direct privacy risk.
assumptions: The process has access to the student's personal information.

title: Grade Record Exposure
description: The assignment service (P2) writes grade records (student id, course, grade, feedback, grader id, timestamp) to the Grade Records Database (DS2). If the database is not properly secured or if the write operation is not restricted to authorized users, sensitive student and course information could be exposed.
assumptions: Assumes the database is not already fully secured.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the database is fully secured; this is a general risk for any write operation to a data store.

title: Data Store Exposure
description: The Grade Records Database (DS2) is a data store. If the database is not properly secured or if the write operation is not restricted to authorized users, sensitive student and course information could be exposed.
assumptions: Assumes the database is not already fully secured.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the database is fully secured; this is a general risk for any write operation to a data store.

title: Unauthorized Access to Personal Data
description: External entity (Student) requests and receives personally identifiable information (PII) from the system without explicit consent or a valid data flow model.
assumptions: The student has not explicitly authorized the system to access their personal grades and feedback.

title: Data Processing of Personal Data
description: The Grades Portal Web App processes personally identifiable information (PII) from the student without a valid data flow model or explicit authorization.
assumptions: The system processes student grades and feedback without a documented data flow model.

title: Grade Display to Student
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) displays student grades to ExternalEntity EE1 (Student). This interaction is valid under the mapping table (Process->ExternalEntity) and exposes sensitive personal data (grades) to an external entity.
assumptions: The portal is accessible to the student.

title: Student Access to Grades
description: ExternalEntity EE1 (Student) accesses and views the grades data. This is a valid interaction (ExternalEntity->Process) and exposes the student's own sensitive personal data to the system.
assumptions: The student has access to the portal.

title: Unauthorized Grade Access
description: Parent (EE2) logs in and requests their child's grades. If the parent account is not properly linked to the child account, or if the system does not enforce access control based on the parent-child relationship, an unauthorized individual could access the child's grades.
assumptions: The parent account is linked to the child account.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the system enforces access control based on the parent-child relationship.

title: Data Exfiltration
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) processes data from Parent (EE2). If the system does not validate the parent-child relationship before processing the request, the parent's account could be used to access the child's grades.
assumptions: The system does not validate the parent-child relationship before processing the request.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the system validates the parent-child relationship.

title: Grade Display to Parent
description: Process P1 (Grades Portal Web App) displays child's grades, feedback, and submission history to ExternalEntity EE2 (Parent). This interaction is valid under the Process->ExternalEntity mapping table, but the display of sensitive personal data (grades, feedback, history) to an external entity without explicit consent or a data processing agreement constitutes a privacy risk.
assumptions: The parent entity has no contractual or legal obligation to receive this specific data set.

title: Parent Access to Child's Data
description: ExternalEntity EE2 (Parent) is receiving data from Process P1. The mapping table indicates this is a valid interaction (ExternalEntity->Process). However, the parent entity is accessing sensitive personal information (grades, feedback, history) without a defined data processing agreement or explicit consent mechanism, which is a privacy risk.
assumptions: The parent entity has no contractual or legal obligation to receive this specific data set.

title: Unauthorized Account Creation
description: ExternalEntity (EE4) creates accounts without proper authorization or verification.

title: Unauthorized Account Modification
description: ExternalEntity (EE4) modifies account details (names, emails, roles) without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Account Disabling
description: ExternalEntity (EE4) disables accounts without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Account Creation
description: Process (P1) creates accounts without proper authorization or verification.

title: Unauthorized Account Modification
description: Process (P1) modifies account details (names, emails, roles) without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Account Disabling
description: Process (P1) disables accounts without authorization.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grading Service
description: An unauthorized user or process may access the grading service (P2) to view or modify account records or parent-child relationship links before they are written to the account directory (DS3).

title: Data Modification by Unauthorized Actor
description: An unauthorized actor may modify the account records or parent-child relationship links stored in the grading service (P2) without proper authorization.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Directory
description: An unauthorized user or process may access the account directory (DS3) to view or modify account records or parent-child relationship links.

title: Data Modification by Unauthorized Actor
description: An unauthorized actor may modify the account records or parent-child relationship links stored in the account directory (DS3) without proper authorization.

title: Data Disclosure to External Entity
description: The process P2 (Assignment & Grading Service) transfers full grade records, assignments, and account directory to the external entity EE5 (Cloud Hosting Provider). This constitutes a data disclosure as the system is transferring personal data to a third party without a direct data store intermediate step, violating the minimality principle.

title: Data Disclosure from External Entity
description: The external entity EE5 (Cloud Hosting Provider) is receiving data from the process P2. While the mapping table excludes ExternalEntity->ExternalEntity flows, the context implies EE5 may be acting as a data store or intermediary. If EE5 is acting as a data store for the process, it would be a valid interaction. However, if EE5 is purely an external entity without modeled data flows, this interaction is invalid. Assuming EE5 is acting as a data store for the process, this represents a data disclosure from the external entity perspective.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if EE5 is acting as a data store or purely an external entity. If EE5 is a data store, this is a valid interaction; if EE5 is purely external, this is an invalid interaction.

title: Grade Records Access
description: DataStore DS2 (Grade Records Database) is accessed by Process P2 (Assignment & Grading Service) to build views for students, parents, and teachers. This interaction is valid under the mapping table (DataStore->Process).
assumptions: The data flow is authorized and the data is not sensitive.

title: Grade Records Access
description: Process P2 (Assignment & Grading Service) accesses DataStore DS2 (Grade Records Database) to retrieve grade records for building views.
assumptions: The process has appropriate access controls and authorization.
